fragments.stage/packages-disabled.md: ADORE has not granted administrative system-package installation. Project libraries may be installed in user-owned directories when allowed.
fragments.recovery/integration-conflict.md: Resolve the current target integration conflict.
fragments.recovery/no-progress.md: Complete or legally route the current AEGIS stage.
fragments.recovery/continuation.md: The preceding attempt made candidate progress and appended work evidence, but this stage remains unfinished. Continue the same job conversation. Run `python .agentic/aegis.py brief TASK-11111111`, consult its current State and read only the journal sections needed for remaining work. Complete the stage and legally advance it. Do not repeat completed work or fabricate a stage transition.
fragments.recovery/revalidation-route.md: The target or candidate changed after approval. Return the AEGIS task TASK-11111111 to validate using the repository's documented transition, review the updated candidate and report the checks appropriate to this repository, including CI-only checks that were not run locally. ADORE will observe the journal rather than rerun tests. Stop after routing the task so ADORE can checkpoint and resume this conversation at the next stage.
fragments.review/pipeline.md: The forge pipeline on the published MR/PR reported `failed`, and this revision exists to make it green. Read the repository's CI configuration, reproduce the failing checks inside this container, and fix the cause. Treat a green pipeline as part of the acceptance criteria for this round.
fragments.system/internet-off.md: Internet access is off for this project: only the model provider and any extra hosts the project allows are reachable. Web search and page reading are unavailable, and downloads (curl, npm install, pip install and the like) fail for every other host; do not retry a refused download. Work with the repository and the tools already installed.
fragments.system/server-internet.md: ADORE does not enforce internet restrictions on this server.
